0022600087.text: Both the Charlotte Hornets and Brooklyn Nets open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Hornets on the road. Charlotte is without Coby White, Grant Williams, Grayson Allen, Kon Knueppel, Kylan Boswell and Moussa Diabate, all listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Brooklyn is missing Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder injury. The Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 win in Brooklyn on March 31, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Charlotte a 60% chance to win.
